summary: Full E2E testing of edwardlongiscool.com completed. Backend pytest suite (10 tests, all passed) covering health, guestbook (CRUD + profanity + empty validation), wall of fame CRUD, visitor counter + increment, AI history + streaming chat + empty-message validation. Playwright UI flow verified: home load, navbar links (garage, wall, guestbook scroll), Wall of Fame submit->appears, Guestbook submit->appears with profanity censored to asterisks, visitor counter renders digits, Edward-bot open -> streamed markdown reply containing 'cool/tall/epic' description of Edward, hidden command-bar via '/' key with help/party/credits commands producing correct output, and konami code (↑↑↓↓←→←→ b a) triggers konami-egg overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: profanity _clean() runs an unbounded while loop on lowercased copy but rebuilds low from mixed-case out - safe here but if a bad word overlapped with '*' could theoretically loop; consider using re.sub with word boundaries for accuracy.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan context managers.
Rate limiter is in-memory per-process; will not work behind multiple workers - acceptable for MVP but note for scale.
seed_data_creation: Test guestbook/wall entries prefixed with TEST_ created via API and UI; not cleaned up (no delete endpoint) but clearly labeled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. AI streaming is plain text/plain chunked, not SSE - already handled. Konami sequence tracked in a rolling buffer on window keydown; '/' key opens command bar only when active element is NOT INPUT/TEXTAREA. All key data-testids: home, navbar, nav-{home,about,garage,retro,photos,wall,guestbook}, wall-{name,note,submit,list,item}, gb-{name,message,submit,list,item}, visitor-counter, ai-{open-btn,close-btn,clear-btn,chat-window,input,send-btn,msg-user,msg-assistant}, command-bar, command-input, konami-egg, matrix-rain.
